items.title: R-universality of the special unitary Lie algebra of a Hermitian form over a quaternion division algebra with the reversion involution
items.author: Dave Witte Morris
items.work: A Cohomological Proof that Real Representations of Semisimple Lie Algebras Have Q-Forms

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the R-universality criterion for the special unitary Lie algebra attached to a Hermitian form over a quaternion division algebra with the reversion involution (author prop at source lines 651-659): universality holds exactly when the quaternion algebra does not split over R. The proof (source lines 661-665) is two sentences long and its content is the reduction to a single Tits algebra — the centre of the symplectic group having order two — and the identification of that algebra with the quaternion division algebra, after which the author's division-algebra description of universality gives the equivalence immediately. The card keeps the author's own level of detail. H2.
